description: This Java class defines a graphical user interface panel (MessagesPanel) that displays debug messages in a scrollable text area with controls like pause and clear buttons, allowing users to manage message display and styling.

classes.name: MessagesPanel
classes.description: A GUI component for displaying and managing debug messages with font customization.

methods.name: MessagesPanel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message display panel with optional extra buttons.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state of message display and updates the pause button text.

methods.name: getButtonPanel
methods.description: Returns the panel containing control buttons.

methods.name: getMessagesScroll
methods.description: Returns the scroll pane containing the message view.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Returns the current font used in the message display.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the font for message display and updates configuration properties.

methods.name: loadFont
methods.description: Loads font settings from configuration and applies them.
